scientific_integrity: Proof concerns each fixed n and sufficiently small pure-state amplitude only. Finite numerical checks are corroborative; 2004 and 2013 standard Wigner identities are credited. The known n=2 special case and 2026 radial escape scale are not independently claimed as new. The full text of arXiv:2504.20324 was not inspected, leaving publication-priority risk.
title: Universal disk geometry of weak vacuum–Fock Wigner negativity
